policy: Suppressions (eslint-disable, @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error, @ts-nocheck, .skip, .skipIf, .only, .fixme) in src/, e2e/ and verify/ may only decrease. Counts are per file and kind. A new one fails CI; so does a removed one that is still listed here, so lower or delete the entry in the same change. This file is a code-owner path: a human approves every edit.
